segments.text: I return you with thanks your nephew’s letter: he has forgotten to mention one most important element, viz whether the eggs floated; if you have any communication with him I particularly wish you wd. ask this question, & tell him to open eggs, as you suggest, if he tries the experiment again. If the eggs do not float or are killed by salt-water it is marvellous how Lizards get on every oceanic island.—
